name: 27877-gsm8kdllm-llada2mini-1gpu
model: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini, a diffusion LLM. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE: the engine's diffusion path looks the architecture up in a fixed table and raises on anything it does not find. Ungated, ~32.5 GB in bf16 over 7 safetensors shards.
parallelism: tp1 on one card; EP=1, PP=1 (the engine pins pipeline parallelism to 1 on this path), no router, no external cache tier, no disaggregation.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, bounded at 1000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed 42, first 10% of the run discarded as warmup.
workload: Five-shot GSM8K, shipped with the item as configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-1000.jsonl: 1000 rows, one turn each, no chat template, raw text to /v1/completions; prompt 865.3 tokens mean (sd 21.3, min 828, max 946), temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, three stop strings, output length unpinned and typically ~124 tokens.
purpose: A grade-school math solver answering five-shot word problems with a compact diffusion model, sixteen concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
model-path: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini

# The checkpoint carries its own modelling code. Required to load it at all.
trust-remote-code: true

# This path admits ONE request at a time when this key is absent, however many clients wait.
max-running-requests: 4

dllm-fdfo: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.9
attention-backend: flashinfer
dllm-algorithm: LowConfidence

# Every integer up to max-running-requests, not a power-of-two ladder: an uncaptured size falls
# back to the eager path. `--cuda-graph-bs` is a deprecated alias forwarded to this same field.
cuda-graph-bs-decode: [1, 2, 3, 4]
